name: Interlace
headline: Check what your coding agents ship.
descriptor: security lint, mutation testing and agent-ready CLIs
subhead: Open-source tools that verify AI-written JavaScript: security lint, mutation testing and agent-ready CLIs. Every claim is a number you can re-run.
tagline: Open-source tools that check what your coding agents ship: security lint, mutation testing and agent-ready CLIs.
footer: Built in the open by Ofri Peretz · MIT License · Independent

products.name: ESLint plugins
products.question: Is the code safe?
products.line: {rules.total} rules in {plugins.total} plugins catch the security bugs AI coding tools write. Every rule maps to a CWE. Runs on ESLint 8–10 and Oxlint.

products.name: oxmutate
products.question: Do the tests check anything?
products.line: Mutation testing for JavaScript and TypeScript. It agrees with Stryker on 99.9% of mutants and hands an agent 326 bytes per surviving mutant instead of 4,094.

products.name: burgee
products.question: Can an agent drive the CLI?
products.line: Everything a CLI needs that isn't your CLI: {packages.burgee} packages, no outside dependencies. One declaration gives help, --json, --schema, MCP and completions; exit codes were right on 100% of agent tasks, against 40% for commander and yargs.

products.name: Serverless plugins
products.line: TypeScript-native Serverless Framework plugins for AWS: API Gateway caching and per-function IAM roles. Remove one and it cleans up what it created.

products.name: Interlace UI
products.line: The design system these sites are built with: accessible React components for shadcn, tested in dark mode and right-to-left.

next.name: API contracts
next.question: Does it match the contract?
next.line: Spec diff and checks for OpenAPI, JSON Schema, MCP and AsyncAPI. In development.
